doctrine: Estel is STC's longitudinal company memory: collect receipts, score the vibe, preserve history, and surface whether a company has improved or worsened enough to feed future campaigns.

roles.shadowfax: Finds smoke: price, volume, options, catalyst scent.
roles.estel: Knows the company: source receipts, legitimacy, fragility, convexity, vibe trend.
roles.citadel: Decides whether the setup deserves campaign/review path.
roles.structure_lab: Builds survivable options architecture only after thesis approval.

vibe_snapshot_fields.vibe_label: improving | worsening | stable_positive | stable_negative | unclear | unverified
vibe_snapshot_fields.unchanged_reasons: Receipt-backed reasons the prior view still holds.
vibe_snapshot_fields.what_to_watch_next: Specific next receipts or catalysts needed.
vibe_snapshot_fields.source_receipt_ids: Local Estel receipt IDs backing the assessment.

next_build_slice: Build local-only Estel vibe snapshot generator for top synced Shadowfax rows, then expose read-only trend badges in /research-candidates.
